title: Lapis Lock
description: Keep your Lapis Lazuli in the Enchanting Table when it's closed
body:
# Lapis Lock
Lapis Lock is a simple quality of life plugin that remembers the Lapis Lazuli left inside an Enchanting Table.

Normally, any lapis remaining in the enchanting interface is returned to the player's inventory when the GUI is closed. With Lapis Lock, the lapis will remain in the inventory, until removed, or the Enchanting Table is closed.
